name: maxxecu-tuning
displayName: MaxxECU MTune Universal Log & Calibration Analyzer
description: Platform-agnostic MaxxECU MTune tuning co-pilot for NA and forced-induction builds (2JZ-GTE, LS, K-series, BMW, rotary, etc.). Parses .MaxxECU-Zip-log, .MaxxECU-log, .maxxlog, .csv, and .MaxxECU-save natively on Windows; validates vehicle configuration against MTune settings; computes damped VE/warmup/AE/boost/knock/idle/Cruise PID recommendations; and audits CAN transmissions including Dodge/BMW 8HP.
suggestedPrompts: Audit my MaxxECU .MaxxECU-save and datalog against my vehicle profile and build a tuning plan
Review this MaxxECU datalog for VE table corrections, knock, boost/WOT fueling, and safety cuts
Diagnose my idle stability, electric fan inrush (PWM vs. relay), cold-start warmup, or Cruise PID
Audit my CAN transmission (8HP/DCT/DSG) shift tables, torque model, and WOT shift cuts
